text:
**Brief: Willow work plan (upload, billing, webhooks, quota, ledger, pricing)**

Hard requirements:
- webhooks max_workers = 14. Only worker alpha may take webhooks.
- pricing timeout_s = 35. Worker alpha owns pricing.
- billing retry_limit = 5.
- ledger timeout_s = 95.
- If ledger.timeout_s > 85, quota.retry_limit ≤ 2.
- If billing.retry_limit > 3, quota.batch_size ≤ 200.
- billing and upload run on different workers.
- quota and upload run on the same worker (shared local cache).
- Execution order: pricing before ledger.
- upload declares a dependency on pricing.
- No dependency path from quota to pricing, direct or transitive.
- types.py and tokens.py belong to upload.
- Code review turnaround under one day.

Everything else, including upload ttl_s and database choices, is team judgment. Ignore legacy values and meeting tangents.
